metaqa.passage_snippet: A Tale of the Wind () is a 1988 French film directed by Joris Ivens and Marceline Loridan. It is also known as A Wind Story. It stars Ivens as he travels in China and tries to capture winds on film, while he reflects on his life and career. The film blends real and fictional elements; it ranges from documentary footage to fantastical dream sequences and Peking opera. It was Ivens' last film.

w2_gold_matched_only_by_endpoint_absent_.passage_snippet: [passage text not included in the release]

reading: The OpenIE KG is built by Llama-3.1-8B, which has seen Wikipedia in pretraining. Each extraction call saw one passage and nothing else, and every edge records its source passage, so a fact supplied from memory would surface as an edge whose endpoint is missing from that passage. On 2WikiMultiHop (both swap splits), 211 of 783 gold evidence triples (26.9%) are reproduced by 233 OpenIE edges with identical normalized endpoints, and the object is absent from the source passage for 0 of these 233 edges (0.0%; Wilson 95% upper bound 1.6%), against 2.8% of all non-gold edges (0.4% when the object string occurs elsewhere in the corpus). One gold triple enters only through edges whose endpoint takes the Wikidata spelling of a name the passage writes differently; all of its tokens are in the passage. On MetaQA the count is 0 of 976 edges (927 of 1,728 KB path triples matched; upper bound 0.4%; non-gold 3.0%). A loose token-containment match raises 2Wiki coverage to 576 triples; 9 of its 864 edges have an object not found verbatim, but in all 9 at least 80% of the object's tokens occur in the passage (merged or clause-length spans). On GraphRAG-Bench medical, 8 of 239 gold-matched edges (3.3%) have an absent object, against 2.6% for non-gold edges with corpus-attested objects; on inspection these are plural, punctuation and paraphrase variants ("biomarker" in a chunk that says "biomarkers"). We therefore find no gold fact that the extractor could only have supplied from memory. The check is limited: it sees only gold triples reproduced with matching surface forms (26.9% of 2Wiki triples under exact matching), it cannot exclude an injection rate below about 1.6% on 2Wiki, and it cannot detect memory acting within a passage, for instance an extractor that recovers passage-stated gold relations more reliably because it has read these pages. The OpenIE KG is grounded in its source passages, but this does not show it is free of pretraining influence.
